correctness.rationale: Dirichlet proportions are uniform and independent of their gamma sum. The ratio event is homogeneous; exact conditional minimum density transforms to Beta(m/(c-1),m), whose variance vanishes. Conditional iid truncated-exponential law and conditional Chebyshev give empirical convergence; normalization, sampling without replacement, extreme order statistics, elementary moments and compact deterministic scaled-coordinate support yield all assertions and L^q. Standalone checks affirm beta algebra and finite sampling but infinite convergence is analytical.
